component.name: Logolig
component.summary: Favicons and logos from one image

description.p: Logolig turns one logo image into the files a website needs. Choose a PNG, SVG, WebP or JPEG file and it makes a favicon set: favicon.ico, PNG icons of several sizes, an Apple touch icon, an SVG and a snippet of HTML to paste into your page.

It can also write a web manifest, a monochrome set and small logo files for the Microsoft Store. The PNG sizes and the options can be changed, and the result can be saved file by file or as one ZIP archive.
Everything happens on your computer: no image is uploaded anywhere. Logolig can be used with the keyboard alone, and its interface is in English and Japanese.

screenshot.caption: The generated assets of a converted logo, each with a Save button

description.p: Everything can now be done from the keyboard, and the controls are clearer.

ul.li: Tab and Shift+Tab reach every control, with a visible focus ring; Enter and Space act like a click and the arrow keys choose within a group
Shortcuts such as Ctrl+1 no longer type into a text field
A new application icon, checkboxes with a tick and a bar beside the active page
On the result screen, Back stays at the top and Download all stays at the bottom, and the Settings page scrolls in a small window
A newer file always wins over an older conversion still running, and a missing file dialog is reported once
